title: 第一卷 第15章 传媳妇功法两女震惊第一卷 第16章 兰雪有嗣回门遭刺杀
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
赵辰安听到这句许诺，心中顿时一乐。
又一桩婚事？
好，太好了！
父皇果然是懂我的。
这大腿，抱得舒坦！
但他面上依旧不动声色，只是躬身一礼，语气诚恳。
“全凭父皇做主。”
赵道霆满意地点了点头，这个儿子，现在是越看越喜欢啊！
可惜，要是能够修炼就更好了！
他将那卷《大荒囚天指》小心翼翼地收好，那郑重的模样，仿佛捧着的是整个大周的未来。
“你且退下吧，朕要闭关几日，参悟这门武技。”
“儿臣告退。”
赵辰安应了一声，转身便要离去。
可他刚走到门口，却又停下了脚步，像是想起了什么。
他转过身，带着几分试探的口吻问道：
“父皇，儿臣还有一个不情之请。”
“说。”
赵道霆此刻心情大好，大手一挥，显得格外宽容。
“之前献上的那门《大道天衍经》，不知……能否传给儿臣的两位妃子？”
话音落下，御书房内刚刚缓和的气氛，瞬间又凝固了。

赵道霆刚刚舒展的身体，重新绷紧。
他静静地看着赵辰安，没有说话，但那股无形的帝王威压，却悄然弥漫开来。
天品功法！
这四个字的分量，比一座城池还要重。
在大周，这等于是镇国之宝，是皇室最核心的秘密。
按照规矩，非储君不可学，甚至，非未来的皇帝不可窥其全貌。
赵辰安的两个妃子？
一个，是战败部落送来的质子圣女。
另一个，是将门之女，虽是忠臣，但终究是外臣。
将此等神功传给她们？
这不合规矩！
赵辰安垂着头，仿佛承受不住那股压力，但他没有退缩。
他知道父皇在顾虑什么。
但他更知道，父皇现在最想要的是什么。
是那虚无缥缈，却又近在咫尺的“仙缘”
果然，在沉默了足足十几息后，赵道霆那沉重的威压缓缓收敛。
content_en:
When Zhao Chenan heard this promise, he felt happy.
Another marriage?
OK, great!
Father indeed understands me.
These thighs are so comfortable to hold!
But his face remained calm, he just bowed and his tone was sincere.
"It's all up to my father to make the decision."
Zhao Daoting nodded with satisfaction. The more he looks at this son, the more he likes him!
It's a pity, it would be better if I could practice!
He carefully put away the volume "The Great Desolate Prisoner's Finger", with a solemn look, as if he was holding the future of the entire Great Zhou Dynasty.
"Please step back. I will stay in seclusion for a few days to master this martial art."
"My son, please retire."
Zhao Chenan responded, turned around and left.
But as soon as he reached the door, he stopped again, as if he remembered something.
He turned around and asked in a somewhat tentative tone:
"Father, I have an unkind request."
"Say."
Zhao Daoting was in a good mood at the moment and waved his hand, appearing particularly tolerant.
"I wonder if the "Dao Tian Yan Jing" that I presented earlier...can be passed on to my two concubines?"
As soon as the words fell, the atmosphere in the royal study that had just relaxed suddenly solidified again.
Zhao Daoting's body that had just stretched became tense again.
He looked at Zhao Chenan quietly without saying a word, but the invisible imperial pressure quietly spread.
Heavenly skills!
The weight of these four words is heavier than a city.
In the Great Zhou Dynasty, this was tantamount to a national treasure and the core secret of the royal family.
According to the rules, only the crown prince cannot learn it, and even the future emperor cannot get a glimpse of it.
Zhao Chenan’s two concubines?
One is the proton saint sent by the defeated tribe.
The other is the daughter of a general. Although she is a loyal minister, she is still a foreign minister.
Pass on these magical skills to them?
This is against the rules!
Zhao Chenan lowered his head, as if he couldn't bear the pressure, but he didn't flinch.
He knew what his father was worried about.
But he knew better what his father wanted most now.
It’s the “immortal fate” that is ethereal yet so close at hand.
Sure enough, after being silent for more than ten breaths, Zhao Daoting's heavy pressure slowly subsided.
